page_title: ALA 0-1 RSO | Alaves v Real Sociedad 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Francisco Maeso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Rafa Marin (Alaves) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
90+3' The ball is out of play and Alaves manage to earn a corner.
90+2' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
88' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
84' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
83' It's time for a substitution. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Arsen Zakharyan.
82' Alaves earn a corner.
81' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
80' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card.
80' A player from Real Sociedad commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Alaves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
78' An attempted cross from Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is cleared.
75' A substitution has been made. Luis Rioja is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samu Omorodion leaves the pitch and Kike Garcia (Alaves) comes on.
75' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) replacing Carlos Vicente.
72' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and it's Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
70' The attendance for today's match is 18575.
69' Substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad).
69' Here is a change. Ander Barrenetxea is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Andre Silva (Real Sociedad).
66' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Ander Guevara is replaced by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
66' Substitution. Jon Guridi will be replaced by Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves).
62' Ander Guevara (Alaves) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
62' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
59' 0 - 1 GOAL! The corner is whipped in and Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
59' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
58' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Real Sociedad have a corner.
56' Alex Remiro is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Samu Omorodion (Alaves). Easy save!
55' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
54' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
54' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.

53' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Sociedad.
52' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
50' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
49' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
48' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Javi Lopez (Alaves) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
45+3' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
45+2' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Antonio Sivera (Alaves) leaps to collect the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Imanol Alguacil is forced to make a change. Takefusa Kubo is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
42' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
39' Jon Guridi (Alaves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
38' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
37' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Luis Rioja (Alaves). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
36' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) picks up a long through ball, but Antonio Sivera deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
31' It's a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
29' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) has a goal ruled out for offside!
28' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Sociedad.
25' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francisco Maeso who sees an offensive foul.
24' The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
21' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
18' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
14' The resulting corner from Luis Rioja (Alaves) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
13' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
12' Rafa Marin (Alaves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick is awarded to Real Sociedad.
10' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
9' Javi Lopez (Alaves) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
8' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
6' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
3' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

2' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Real Sociedad will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francisco Maeso.
